name: wfh-skill-test
description: Fullstack Developer Skill Test - Aplikasi Absensi WFH Karyawan & Monitoring Karyawan (NestJS Microservices + MySQL + Prisma + React RBAC)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend/attendance-app install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n GATEWAY,AUTH,EMPLOYEE,ATTENDANCE,FRONTEND -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run start:gateway" "npm --prefix backend run start:auth" "npm --prefix backend run start:employee" "npm --prefix backend run start:attendance" "npm --prefix frontend/attendance-app run dev"
